discription: A bright, percussive sound using a Sawtooth oscillator with a very short attack and quick decay envelope, ideal for staccato melodies or arpeggiated sequences.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, pan=0; var sig; var env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.001, 0.05, 0.0, 0.2, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2); sig = Saw.ar(freq) * amp * env; Out.ar(out, Pan2.ar(sig, pan)); }
